summary.text: Linda Featherston is a Democratic state representative who has represented District 16 since January 2021 and is seeking re-election on November 3, 2026.
A piano teacher and studio owner, she is the ranking minority member on the House Local Government and Agriculture committees.

paragraphs.text: Linda Featherston was born in Topeka, Kansas, and graduated from Topeka High School.
She earned a bachelor's degree from Kansas State University in 1993 and a graduate degree there in 1997.

Her career experience includes working as an independent piano teacher and owning and operating an independent piano studio, and she is affiliated with the Kansas City Music Teachers Association, the Kansas Music Teachers Association and the Greater Kansas Women's Political Caucus.
Featherston took office in the Kansas House on January 11, 2021, succeeding Cindy Holscher.
For 2025 and 2026 she is assigned to the House Education, House Local Government, Water and Agriculture committees, serving as ranking minority member on Local Government and Agriculture.

In a Ballotpedia survey, she said she has been an advocate for public schools and universities and listed laws she has led efforts on, including increasing the penalty for attacking an on-duty hospital worker, expanding protections for survivors of domestic abuse and human trafficking, and expanding coverage of diagnostic breast imaging.
She also said she supports fully funding public schools, including special education.
